rationale: Two of three personas show strong pain + buying power at target price point.
Maya (solo consultant) is a clear champion; Diego (agency owner) requires team / data-residency story.
The 'zero forms' wedge is genuinely differentiated; no incumbent ships this as the default experience.
Skeptic persona Priya signals that the bottom of the ICP ($15/mo ceiling, AI-distrustful) is NOT the wedge.

assumptionAudit.assumption: Solo operators abandon traditional CRMs within 30 days.
Users will trust an LLM to read their inbox if data stays in their tenant.
Pricing at <$30/mo removes the 'do I need this?' objection.
Gmail + Calendar integration covers 80% of the market.

riskRegister.risk: BYOK + inbox read access is a high-trust posture; objection rate may suppress trial-to-paid.
riskRegister.mitigation: Lead with 'your tenant, your key' messaging; offer on-device summarisation tier.

riskRegister.risk: Incumbent (HubSpot Free) is sticky and free.
riskRegister.mitigation: Position against effort, not features; '0 fields to fill' as the headline.

riskRegister.risk: Outlook gap excludes ~25% of SMB market in year 1.
riskRegister.mitigation: Ship Outlook integration by month 6; gate enterprise outreach until then.

pivotNotes: Drop bottom-end persona (Priya). Anchor pricing at $29 solo / $79 team — not $15.
Lead with 'AI-drafts-your-next-email' demo, not pipeline visualisation.
Add 'data stays in your Google tenant' as a first-class trust message; defer Outlook to v1.1.
goConditions: 5 solo-consultant design partners signed before scaffolding starts.
BYOK story validated with 3 of those 5 in writing.
<$120 blended CAC modelled on a 90-day plan.
